correctness.rationale: Conditional arclength is uniform in the affine edge parameter. For the two-plus-one configuration a slice through the centroid forces w>=1/2 and requires two independent uniforms to straddle w/(3w-1); integration gives 1/9+4 log(2)/27. For one per side, failure of any specified oriented-edge test has probability 1/2-integral_0^(1/2) (1-u)/(2-3u) du. The three failures are disjoint up to null sets: each requires opposite halves of the parameters at its two consecutive edges, and sharing an edge would require both halves for the same parameter. Cyclic symmetry therefore gives 2 log(2)/3. The multinomial occupancy probabilities yield the cubic, including zero weights. Strict pair balancing increases xy with x+y fixed and hence increases e2 and e3 with positive coefficients. The strict p_i<1/2 bound gives sum p_i^2<1/2, and only the permutations of (1/2,1/2,0) have limiting equality; the equilateral upper equality follows from the sharp e2 and e3 bounds. Same-edge triples cannot contain the centroid. Checked RESULT.md lines 25–88 and the packaged symbolic/Monte Carlo logic; the supplied script was not executed. The analytic check does not depend on sampling.
